name: of Narvi
description: Bright mithril bracers from the forge of Narvi, who made the Doors of Durin with Celebrimbor's help. Three empty settings wait for stones worthy of them.

name: of Beorn
description: Heavy iron bracers, too wide for any common arm, that once belonged to the skin-changer of the Carrock. Wearing them, you heal as a great bear heals.

name: of the Hornburg
description: Battered bracers of the Westfold, worn on the Deeping Wall the night it held. Nothing has broken them yet.

name: of Haldir
description: Soft grey bracers of the Galadhrim, laced with silver thread. The march-warden of Lórien wore them on the borders of the Golden Wood.

name: of Bilbo Baggins
description: A roomy, well-mended pack that went There and Back Again. Whatever is inside comes through fire and frost unharmed — a dragon's lair taught it that.

name: 'Thorn'
description: A slim dagger of Dale, light enough to fight with in the off hand. It hates orcs as a thorn hates the hand that grasps it.

name: of Dol Amroth
description: A parrying blade of the Swan Knights, made to be held in the left hand while the right does the killing.

name: of Narvi
description: The mattock that cut the halls of the West-gate. It finds the richest part of any vein: half as much gold again from every one you dig.

name: of Strider
description: Weather-stained boots of a Ranger of the North, broken to long marches under a heavy load. Wearing them you carry a third more before you're slowed.
